notes.title: Server Stabilization Patch (No Downtime)
notes.notes:
To ensure a more stable service, server stabilization work will soon be carried out.



This process does not require scheduled maintenance, but the server list may temporarily not appear.

If this happens, please fully exit and restart the game.



Additionally, some ongoing queues may be reset.



We sincerely appreciate the incredible interest you've shown in the Chrono Odyssey Closed Beta Test,

and we are doing our utmost to provide a stable testing environment.



Thank you.

notes.title: [Update] NA Server Experiencing Instability
notes.notes:
Greetings Sentinels,



We’d like to share an update regarding the recent server instability affecting the NA region.



At this time, the NA servers have shown signs of stabilization, and the frequency of related issues has been reduced. However, we are aware that some disruptions may still occur, and our team will continue to closely monitor server activity to ensure improved performance going forward.



We understand that connectivity issues can be frustrating, especially during an important testing phase, and we deeply appreciate your patience and understanding as we’ve worked through these challenges.



[strike]The NA-03 / NA-42 / NA-25 servers are currently experiencing instability.[/strike]

[strike]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and are actively working to resolve the issue as quickly as possible.[/strike]



Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Server Expansion and Access Distribution Update (Updated: 6/20 7:30 PDT)
notes.notes:
Greetings Sentinels,



To allow more players to join the test, a server expansion work along with additional access will soon take place. 



※ During the preparation phase for the server expansion, queue sessions may be temporarily cleared.

※ The server list may not be fully displayed. If this happens, please close the game completely and restart the game.



Once the preparation is complete, server openings and access distribution will proceed sequentially. 



[New Servers]

- NA 7 ~ [strike]30 [/strike] → 70

- EU 7 ~ [strike]30[/strike] → 70

- ASIA 13 ~ [strike]30[/strike] → 70



We sincerely appreciate your interest in the Chrono Odyssey Closed Beta.

We are committed to providing a smooth and stable testing experience for everyone.



Thank you for your continued interest and support!
